verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email has an in-builder AI Assistant, so connecting MCP servers to give it extra tools is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions MCP client support or any way to plug external tool servers into the product. Its REST API and Zapier integration are different integration features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
